rules: Overlines must be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient glows for active elements, dark deep shadows for elevated cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #333333 (border-white/10 in Tailwind) to separate dark surfaces.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10 for sticky headers and bottom cart sheets. NEVER fully transparent.

layouts.homepage: Hero full height (min-h-[80vh]) with dark overlay. Sections below use wide spacing (py-24). Bento grid for Best Sellers / Today's Special.
layouts.menu_section: Horizontal scroll (mobile) or grid-cols-4 (desktop) for menu categories. Menu items in a dense grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with large tap targets.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout. High density table (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4) for menu items. Sharp edges, minimal padding for data density.

motion.hover: Smooth scale up (scale-105) for food images on hover. Buttons translate-y-[-2px] with glow.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease. NO transition-all.

components.menu_card: Flat surface (bg-neutral-900), rounded-2xl, overflow-hidden. Image at top (h-48 object-cover). Content p-4. Plus/Minus quantity selector integrated.
components.category_pills: Pill shaped (rounded-full), bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-300, active state: bg-amber-500 text-black font-semibold.
components.cart_sheet: Fixed bottom-0 w-full rounded-t-3xl glassmorphism. Slide up animation.
components.admin_table: Shadcn Table component, customized with dark rows, hover:bg-neutral-800.

hero_background.description: Dimly lit elegant restaurant interior for homepage hero.

general_food.description: Table topped with premium food dishes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Ensure the .js (.jsx) extension approach is strictly followed instead of .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a mobile-first, app-like experience for the ordering flow (critical for restaurant platforms).
Use Shadcn UI for complex interactions, but completely strip the default Vercel-look to match the dark luxury theme.
No online payments backend logic. Checkout form just collects user details and outputs a WhatsApp-formatted string (window.open with wa.me link).
Admin uses Google Login (use simple mock or standard OAuth integration).
Ensure all food cards have a visible veg/non-veg indicator (green/red dot).
Add prominent party booking section visually distinct from the standard menu.
Implement search and category filter smoothly without page reloads.
accessibility: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Ensure text contrast over images (use bg-black/50 or gradient overlays).
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays. ALWAYS use backdrop blur with a tint.
